compressed.title: Compressed extensions
compressed.description: Comma-separated; files with these extensions go to the "Compressed" folder

compressedPath.title: Compressed folder
compressedPath.description: Where these files go. Empty = "Compressed" inside the download folder. A relative name is created inside the download folder; an absolute path (e.g. /Users/me/Videos or D:\\Videos) is used as-is.

custom.title: Custom categories
custom.description: Extra folders as Folder=ext,ext separated by ";" (Folder may be a relative name or an absolute path), e.g. Images=jpg,png;/Users/me/Books=epub,mobi. Overrides the lists above.
